ApprovalMode.Name: Approval
ApprovalMode.Hint: Who has to agree when a player gives something to another character. Giving to the party and taking from it never needs the recipient's answer.

Choices.recipient: The recipient's player (the GM answers if they're offline)
Choices.gm: The GM, for every give, take, purchase and sale

GiveTargets.Name: Players Can Give To
GiveTargets.Hint: The primary party actor is always a recipient. Without a primary party, players can give to all player characters.

Choices.players: All player characters and party members

AllowTake.Name: Taking from the Party
AllowTake.Hint: Players can take items and money from a group actor they can see into a character they own.

AllowCurrency.Name: Money Transfers
AllowCurrency.Hint: Players can give money to others and take money from the party.

MaxDistance.Name: Maximum Distance
MaxDistance.Hint: How close two characters' tokens must be on the current scene to hand something over, in the scene's grid units. 0 turns this off. Doesn't apply to the party actor or to the GM.

CombatRule.Name: During Combat
CombatRule.Hint: Applies when one of the two characters is in a started combat. Doesn't apply to the party actor or to the GM.

Choices.remind: Allow, and remind that it uses the object interaction

ChatMessages.Name: Chat Messages
ChatMessages.Hint: Post a chat message for each transfer.

Choices.whisper: Only the players involved and the GM

TokenDrop.Name: Give by Dropping onto a Token
TokenDrop.Hint: Dropping one of your items onto another character's token opens the give dialog.

Buying.Name: Buying
Buying.Hint: Players can use "Buy…" in an item's menu to buy it and pay its price. From a character, NPC or group whose sheet they can see, the money goes to the seller; buying from another player's character needs that player's OK. Copies of items from the Items sidebar and compendiums just cost the money. The GM can always buy for anyone.

Choices.all: Also from the Items sidebar and compendiums

AllowSelling.Name: Selling
AllowSelling.Hint: Players can sell items of their characters, and of groups they belong to when taking from the party is allowed, with "Sell…" in the item's menu. The item goes into the "Sold Items" world compendium (a folder per seller) and the seller gets the money: half price by default, full price for gemstones, art objects, trade goods and treasure, or a custom price.

Undo.Title: Undo Transfer
Undo.Confirm: Reverse this transfer? Items and money go back to where they came from.

Error.Missing: Can't undo: the item or one of the characters no longer exists.
Error.ItemChanged: Can't undo: {name} no longer has all of the item (it was used, moved or sold since).
Error.MoneySpent: Can't undo: {name} no longer has the money.
Error.NotAllowed: Can't undo: this message touches characters its player doesn't own.
Error.AlreadyUndone: This transfer has already been undone.
Error.Failed: The undo failed partway. See the console (F12) for details.
Error.PackLocked: Can't undo: the compendium "{name}" is locked.
